summary_en: TKP Corporation announced its first dividend of 30 yen per share for the fiscal year ending February 2027, with a record date of February 28, 2027. Since its listing in 2017, the company had retained earnings to strengthen operations; improved business progress and financial condition now enable concurrent growth investment and profit distribution, with a target consolidated payout ratio of approximately 30% on an annual basis.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Initial Dividend)
translation_en_brief: TKP Corporation announced on October 15, 2026 that it will pay its first dividend of 30 yen per share for the fiscal year ending February 28, 2027, with a record date of February 28, 2027. The company has maintained zero dividend distributions since its listing in 2017, prioritizing internal reserves to expand business scale and strengthen financial structure. However, reflecting improved business progress, reinforced revenue base, and enhanced financial condition, management determined that the company can now pursue medium-to-long-term growth investment while distributing profits to shareholders. The company stated that going forward, it will conduct year-end dividends with a target consolidated payout ratio of approximately 30%, aiming to achieve stable and sustainable shareholder returns in line with profit growth.
